test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 16 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'ACHIEVE' is written as 'XHENBAB' and 'NUMBERS' is written as 'KZJGBWP'. How will 'CAPTAIN' be written in that language?
solution:
The position of letters according to the English alphabet series:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a1f1c2e0e287e69cf4678c429807103b753e0dd63cdb4c9fb12ff6a7e198b59.png] 

'ACHIEVE' is written as 'XHENBAB' 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7e02c379bbe16431a3f2eaa3d04b48915f9c31d0ad8c92eaad09e55aeaa9db58.png] 

And,

'NUMBERS' is written as 'KZJGBWP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d7dfd95871270bcabfe13f1ee18d67d11d9ad147ae4af4c12f876e79ea2beeb.png] 

Similarly,

'CAPTAIN' be written as '?'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d15349e094d271ed1001989b1647bf35f0f0de38d531dbc6af595ea115910c17.png] 

Hence, the correct answer **ZFMYXNK".**
